about: A command line tool for automating tasks, like a Python version of make.

prs.title: Running tasks in parallel works on Python 3.14
prs.broken: On Python 3.14, running tasks in parallel crashed at start if the task file had any small inline function, because Python changed how it starts worker processes on Linux.
prs.changed: The tool now uses the old way of starting workers where it is available.
prs.matters: People can upgrade to Python 3.14 without their parallel builds breaking.
